Specification coverage

The HuddleSpec defines the structure of valid on-chain data. From it we derive obligations: each one names a specific case the dataset should exercise with at least one sample. An obligation may call for a sample that is valid or for one that is invalid. The report below lists every obligation and whether the dataset fulfills it.

fulfilled
At least one sample fulfills the obligation.
outstanding
Measured against every candidate sample, and none of them met it.
untested
Could not be measured against any sample.
